This procedure takes some time and is performed in the background.
The more private keys you have the longer it takes, please be patient. For example, if you have around 1000 private keys, it could take more than 3 hours to reach full sync.
We will inform you when it is done.

You can always check the sync progress here: Settings -> Bitcoin Cash module.

Set as default Tap for %s SegWit compatible (P2SH) SegWit native (Bech32) All change will be returned to a native SegWit address. These transactions will be the cheapest possible, but transactions will be more identifiable on the blockchain because Bech32 addresses are not yet widely used. Segwit compatible (P2SH) All change will be returned to a legacy compatible SegWit address (P2SH). There are no additional privacy implications. This option has slightly higher fees than SegWit native. Privacy Guard (default) All change will be returned to the address type of the receiver, making it more difficult for blockchain analytics to identify which is the receiving address and which is the change address. These transactions cost 20 to 30 percent more in fees when sending to non-Bech32 addresses.
